headline: Discussed board and commission appointment process, no formal action taken
summary: The committee adopted the agenda and prior minutes, then heard public comments on improving board and commission appointments. Members discussed their approach to reviewing the appointment process and set their next meeting for October 15.
plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Charter Change Committee 
 Thursday, September 17, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1st Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Becca Brown McKnight (Chair), Gene Bergman, Buddy Singh, Marek 
Broderick 
  
Staff Present: Jessica Brown (City Attorney) 
 
Public Present: Melo Grant (City Councilor), Laura Sanchez-Parkinson (City Councilor) 
 
Meeting called to order at 12:03 PM by Councilor McKnight. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
Motion to Adopt Agenda as written.  
 
Motion by Councilor Bergman, Seconded by Councilor Broderick 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.   Adopt the Minutes 
     2.01 Motion to adopt draft minutes from November 10, 2025 
  
Motion to adopt draft minutes from November 10, 2025 as written.   
 
Motion by Councilor Bergman, Seconded by Councilor Broderick 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
3.    Public Forum 
      3.01 Verbal Comments 
 
Councilor Grant commented agreement with the memo drafted by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
and Jen Zakaras of the Mayor’s Office and expressed support for improving the board and 
commission appointment process.   
 
Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson spoke to standardizing the selection process for appointments in 
the interest of accessibility and inclusivity, proposing several aspects to improve as listed in a 
memo to be provided for the Committee’s consideration.  
 
Public forum closed at 12:15 PM.
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
4.    Board and Commission Appointment Process 
      4.01 Board and Commission Appointment Process 
 
The Committee discussed their approach to the charter change item to include: 
• Hearing from prior applicants and city staff managing the process 
• Analyzing board and commission requirements 
• Recruitment and guidance on board/commission members’ responsibilities 
• Creating a list to capture and track all ideas 
 
The Committee set their next meeting for October 15.  No action was taken.  
 
5.   Other Committee Business 
     5.01 Other Committee Business 
 
No action was taken.  
 
6.  Adjournment 
     6.01 Motion to adjourn 
 
The meeting was adjourned with no objection at 12:52 PM.
